name: Full Adder Circuit
objectives: Perform addition of three 1-bit binary numbers (A, B, and Carry-In Cin).
Construct Sum and Carry-Out logic using 2 XOR (7486), 2 AND (7408), and 1 OR (7432) gates.
Synthesize Full Adder using Universal NAND (7400) or NOR (7402) gate ICs.
theory: A Full Adder adds three 1-bit binary inputs: A, B, and Cin. Outputs: Sum (S = A ⊕ B ⊕ Cin) and Carry Out (Cout = (A·B) + (Cin·(A⊕B))).

foundation.title: Foundation (Basic Gates)
foundation.description: Construct Full Adder using 2 XOR (IC 7486), 2 AND (IC 7408), and 1 OR (IC 7432) gate packages.

optimization.title: Universal NAND Gate Synthesis
optimization.description: Rebuild the Full Adder using ONLY Universal NAND gates (IC 7400).

industrial.title: Universal NOR Gate Synthesis
industrial.description: Rebuild the Full Adder using ONLY Universal NOR gates (IC 7402).
